findings.title: IH01 degradation handlers are both forbidden and required in the declared active rollout set
findings.requirement: R-08 requires a complete, unambiguous status model, and the round-10 effect-first correction requires a legal degradation path for every active rollout/Effect interval.
evidence: docs/state-transition-manifests.md §15.7 defines the active set to include `CANARY_RUNNING`, `WIDENING_EFFECT`, `APPROVED`, `PROMOTING`, `PROMOTED`, and `OBSERVING`.
The same normative paragraph states, without a qualifier, ‘IH01 is legal only outside that active set.’
The next sentence requires IH01-C/W/WV/A/P/PV/D/O to handle every member, and the IH01-W/P rows specifically source WIDENING_EFFECT/PROMOTING.
findings.impact: A conforming compiler or checker cannot decide whether degradation transitions are legal from active rollout states. Enforcing the prohibition leaves the effect-first degradation path undefined; enforcing the rows violates the universal invariant. This is a direct normative contradiction on a safety path.
findings.required_correction: Replace ‘IH01 is legal only outside that active set’ with an exact rule that distinguishes ordinary progress/exposure rows from the IH01 degradation-interrupt rows. State explicitly that IH01-C/W/WV/A/P/PV/D/O are the only legal HEALTHY-to-degraded interrupts for the enumerated active states, then require the generated checker to reject all other rows once health or continuity is not current. Regenerate the schema-3 graph and current digests after the normative-byte change.
